song.title: Come on rejoice and let your heart sing
song.lyrics:
[C1] Come on rejoice, and let your heart sing; Come on rejoice, give praise to the King! Come on rejoice, and let your heart sing, Come on rejoice, give praise to the King!
[V1] Sing hallelujah, He is the Lord of Lords, Sing hallelujah, He'll reign forevermore.
[V2] Sing hallelujah, He is the Son of God, Sing hallelujah, for us He shed His blood.
[V3] Sing hallelujah, He is the Prince of Peace, Sing hallelujah, our joy will never cease, Singing hallelujah, hallelujah, hallelujah, To our King!
song.author: Frank Hernandez
